desc: Read the input values for $H$, $W$, the initial grid $A$, and the number of queries $Q$.
Compute the initial DP table where $DP[i][j]$ is the sum of path products to cell $(i,j)$ using the recurrence relation $DP[i][j] = (DP[i-1][j] + DP[i][j-1]) \times A_{i,j} \pmod{998244353}$.
Implement a function to update the DP table when a specific cell $(r, c)$ changes its value $A_{r,c}$:
Propagate the change to all cells $(i, j)$ where $i \ge r$ and $j \ge c$ by recalculating their DP values in order (row by row, then column by column).
Parse the direction and value to determine the new coordinates $(h, w)$ and the new value $a_i$.
Call the update function for $(h, w)$.
Run the code on the sample inputs to verify correctness.
